primary_edition_scope: 周相《大明大統曆法》明隆慶三年（1569）刊本
normalization_note: 行度 uses source 1e-4-degree display; 捷法 is a historical fixed-point reciprocal multiplier. Decimal strings are normalized machine forms, not modern physical units.

shortcut_formula.historical_text: 右置八百二十以遲行度而一為捷法。
shortcut_formula.normalized: truncate_7dp(820 / corresponding line-speed integer at 1e-4-degree scale)
shortcut_formula.symmetry: The same construction is applied to 疾曆行度 and 遲曆行度 columns.
shortcut_formula.output_precision: seven decimal places in normalized shortcut ratio

source_vs_reconstruction_policy: Formula values remain PENDING until directly read from the primary page. Only DIRECT_PRIMARY_MATCH counts as glyph-collated.
